description: Storing a whole board project as one stream split into sections (settings, device setup, VM program), verifying its CRC-32, running it and erasing it.

commands.label: Start storing a project
commands.description: Opens an upload session for a project of the given length in bytes, with its flags (autostart, run at once).

fields.label: Stream length
fields.description: Total size of the stream being uploaded, in bytes

fields.label: Option flags
fields.description: Bit 0 (0x01): autostart after a restart; bit 1 (0x02): run at once after the commit

commands.label: Write a chunk of the project
commands.description: Uploads the next piece of the project stream at the given byte offset.

fields.label: Chunk data
fields.description: Raw bytes of the stream chunk (runs to the end of the frame)

commands.label: Commit the project
commands.description: Verifies the CRC-32 and that all the sections fit together, stores the project in Flash and optionally runs it.

fields.label: CRC-32 checksum
fields.description: CRC-32 checksum of the whole stream

commands.label: Cancel the project upload
commands.description: Aborts the open upload session and clears the working buffer, leaving the project stored before untouched.

commands.label: Read the project state
commands.description: Returns what is known about the stored project: whether there is one, autostart, the active memory bank, the CRC-32 and the size.

fields.label: Project stored
fields.description: 1 = a project is stored in Flash, 0 = none

fields.label: Autostart
fields.description: 1 = the project runs by itself when the board starts

fields.label: Active bank
fields.description: Index of the active Flash bank (0 or 1)

fields.label: Project size
fields.description: Total size of the stored project, in bytes

commands.label: Run the stored project
commands.description: Replays every section and command of the stored project (RUN_ALL of the project record).

commands.label: Erase the stored project
commands.description: Removes the devices the project created (the board's stay), the stored project and its program records. Stop the VM first.

commands.label: Set the project options
commands.description: Sets the project options, e.g. the autostart flag.

write.description: Sets the project options, e.g. the autostart flag.

commands.label: Header of a stream section
commands.description: Opens a section inside the project stream (refused as a command of its own).

fields.label: Record ID
fields.description: ID of the record the section goes to (0 = the program)

commands.label: Project record marker
commands.description: First frame of the project record: the bank, the CRC-32 and the length (does nothing when replayed).
